summary: Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K providing a pre-year-end operational update for FY26. The update highlights the company's 11th consecutive year meeting gold production guidance (1.4-1.5Moz), strong cash generation, and progress at its CSA copper mine and Eva Copper project. No specific deal terms are disclosed; the filing is a routine business update by the foreign private issuer. It does not announce or relate to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
